maria: Heads-up — I implemented a preview endpoint for runtime configs to test safe rollouts. Need ops + console review.
chris: Nice — does it run a dry-run against the routing/quota pipeline or just validation?
maria: Dry-run. It simulates request routing and quota calc using current traffic sample and returns a telemetry summary + a 'safety_score'.
ellen: What sampling rate are we using? Full-fidelity would be expensive.
maria: Default 1% sample over 30m; adjustable via ?sample= & window=. Also support a 'cohort' param to target specific customer buckets.
raj: Can we add a "safety-fuse" threshold? If safety_score > 0.05, mark preview as unsafe and block rollout.
chris: Agree. Also need a metric set for the console: preview PASS/FAIL, delta_rps, delta_p99, cohort_skew indicators.
maria: Adding. API prototype: `POST /api/v1/configs/preview` body: {config, sample, window} returns report_id and summary. Example curl: ```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/configs/preview \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"config":"...","sample":0.01,"window_mins":30}'
```
ops-bot: note: console deploy window 01:00-03:00 UTC tonight for the safety tab change.
ellen: We should gate rollouts on telemetry: allow rollout only if preview run had no alerts and anomaly_score < 0.02 for 1h.
raj: Also define fallback: if rollout triggers trip, either auto-rollback or route affected traffic to stable model variant. Which do we prefer?
chris: We already have routing fallback; need to wire preview thresholds into the rollout policy so it can choose auto-rollback + fallback route.
maria: Proposed triggers: auto-rollback if p95 latency increases >5% OR error_rate increases by absolute 0.5%. Console shows "rollback triggers hit" and ops can override.
deploy-bot: preview:report:6159991300 created by maria. status: ready.
maria: UX question — put preview on the flag page inline or a separate "safety" tab with history & compare?
ellen: Safety tab wins. Keep flag page simple, link to latest preview. Safety tab can let you re-run with same params and compare two runs side-by-side.
raj: Also add a small viz: cohort heatmap + delta histogram (helps spot a single cohort regressing).
chris: :thumbsup: I'll wire telemetry metrics and expose a monotonic gauge `config.safety_score`.
maria: Great. I'll open a PR for the API + console changes and update the rollout-fuses doc. tagging @ops-team on the rollout fuses section for review. Thanks all.
ops-bot: ops: FYI @ops-team — console deploy scheduled. Ping if any blackout windows.
